correctness.rationale: For every integer F>=3, the reflection of each block [u,v] in S intersect [0,F] forces the disjoint gap block [F-v-1,F-u], proving 2g>=F+1+r. Equality and near-equality allow at most two positive blocks. Endpoint comparison classifies odd and even cases and the addition law gives exactly ceil((F+1)/3)<=a<=floor(F/2)-1. Direct brute enumeration for F=3..20 detects no omitted or smaller genus semigroups, and family constructors check through F=300; the unbounded proof does not rely on enumeration.

value.rationale: The originating fixed-Frobenius covariety study explicitly computes the least genus through enumerating maximal members. A closed expression for every F together with an exhaustive structural classification of all minimizers eliminates that enumeration at the extremal layer, proves unique odd extremizers, and gives a growing exact even-Frobenius census. Those classification and enumeration facts are additional mathematical substance beyond the elementary genus lower bound.
